name: Brownie
gmNotes: Canon supplied by brief. Brownie is a fey role, not a Species; no Brownie Archetype file exists yet — link /subjects when the world record is created. expertRegions set to the campaign's home region (Ireland) as a placeholder; adjust per card. Images left empty pending art direction.
deepLore: Brownies wear ragged brown clothes. They are often linked to a fireplace, secretly perform household chores, and are traditionally paid in milk or cream. They may leave when offered clothes or a meal.
description: A helpful but capricious and elusive household spirit who works while the family sleeps.
feyKnowledge: Brownies are lower-ranking domestic helper-Fey, usually under contract from a lab or milk hub. Direct payment, gifts, formal naming, or explicit gratitude-settlement may break or terminate the contract. They wear brown filters, usually caps, which protect them from house dust and smoke.
unlockGuidance: Deep Lore: household elders, storytellers, or Granny may know brownie customs; if feyLoreUnlocksDeepLore is set and the party has Fey Lore, grant Deep Lore at first discovery. Fey Knowledge: reveal through a mission, revelation, or a domestic helper-Fey — asking a Fey may require a Bargain or Grace consequences.
commonKnowledge: Brownies or Hobs are helpful but capricious and elusive household spirits who perform work while the family sleeps.
